related.title: Voyager 星際探測計畫
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付取樣圖、缺幀表及可解析頻段，避免把顯示動畫流暢度當時間解析力。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver sampling plots,gap ledger and resolvable band,not animation smoothness as temporal resolution.
related.difference: 建立長通訊延遲下的指令、執行與確認時間軸，避免重複指令。
related.differenceEn: Build command,execution and acknowledgment timelines under long light-time delay and prevent duplicate commands.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 畫 60 s 正弦與每 12 s 樣本，求 fs、訊號頻率及奈奎斯特頻率。
先算秒再換小時，於時間線標 16.6667 與 33.3333 h。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Plot a 60 s sine sampled every 12 s and calculate sampling,signal and Nyquist frequencies.
Calculate seconds,convert to hours and mark 16.6667 and 33.3333 h on the timeline.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Venus Express 金星大氣探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付取樣圖、缺幀表及可解析頻段，避免把顯示動畫流暢度當時間解析力。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver sampling plots,gap ledger and resolvable band,not animation smoothness as temporal resolution.
related.difference: 以可追溯的兩時刻雲圖估計表觀雲移速率，辨認配準誤差。
related.differenceEn: Estimate apparent cloud drift from two traceable images and distinguish registration error.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 畫 60 s 正弦與每 12 s 樣本，求 fs、訊號頻率及奈奎斯特頻率。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成雲標記位移 240 km，影像相隔 40 min，忽略投影縮短。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：v=240000/(40×60)。 結果約 100 m/s。局部平面且高度固定時 v=位移/時間；影像特徵不一定是同一空氣團。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Plot a 60 s sine sampled every 12 s and calculate sampling,signal and Nyquist frequencies.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic cloud displacement is 240 km over 40 min, neglecting foreshortening. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: v=240000/(40×60). Result ≈ 100 m/s. For a local plane at fixed altitude, v=displacement/time; an image feature need not track the same air parcel.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
